record.body:
## Description

Prove the phase exit criteria hold together: skills and contract match the thin atomic claim chain, plan-trace/consistency are green, and the real adaptive-artifacts create/capture path accepts a thin deliver shape.

## Approach

1. Run the integration acceptance (CLI create/capture / plan-trace path) first.
2. Run skill↔contract consistency and plan-trace suite for this phase.
3. Confirm contract criterion optional and views no longer require criterion (via the criterion_optional_in_contract test).
4. Do not edit product code unless a verify failure forces a fix task — prefer recording evidence.

payload.title: Verify atomic claims and thin acceptances
